name: Point of Order
description: Rules the target out of order. It is bound by the terms of the room.

name: Gavel
description: The chair decides, and the chair has a hammer.

name: Redaction
description: Strikes the record. Everything it touches loses a thread and a line.

name: Read the Minutes
description: Says aloud exactly where the target was standing. Nothing misses it.

name: Proxy Vote
description: Votes everyone else's shares. The whole side hits harder.

name: Claim in Perpetuity
description: States the position across every century at once. Armor does not apply to a legal fact.

name: Foreclose
description: Calls in the whole position against one holder.
